faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBRC Project Technical Support-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the NBRC Project Technical Support-I recruitment is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: For the Project Technical Support-I post, a Bachelor's or Diploma is preferred. Additionally, candidates should have experience in medical record keeping, filing research files, basic data handling, sample collection, and patient handling. Knowledge of Matlab, Python/R, and MRI data processing is also beneficial.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support-I position is 35 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government rules, which are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support-I post will receive a salary of Rs. 18,000 per month, plus HRA as per applicable norms. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NBRC Project Technical Support-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NBRC Project Technical Support-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for the NBRC Project Technical Support-I recruitment is ₹200 for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form as per the instructions in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support-I post at NBRC involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Project Technical Support-I position at NBRC is a contractual job. The duration of the contract will be as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Brain Research Centre located?
faq.answer: The National Brain Research Centre (NBRC) is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122052.
